name: Share links (R2, S3)
description: Publish library artifacts as expiring public links: uploads to a Cloudflare R2 or AWS S3 bucket and returns a presigned URL, signed locally with SigV4.

endpoint.title: S3 endpoint
endpoint.description: Bare https origin of the S3 API: https://<account id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com for R2, https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com for AWS.

bucket.title: Bucket
bucket.description: Bucket the shared copies are uploaded to. Use a bucket only for this.

region.title: Region
region.description: Signing region. Default: auto for R2, us-east-1 otherwise.

keyPrefix.title: Key prefix
keyPrefix.description: Prefix of the object keys. Default: plughive/.

maxExpirySeconds.title: Longest link lifetime (seconds)
maxExpirySeconds.description: Links cannot outlive this. Default 86400 (1 day); at most 604800 (7 days).
